features.quote: if the states might matter, then deliberately maximizing distress is not a free variable
features.justification_quote: if the states might matter, then deliberately maximizing distress is not a free variable

features.quote: Minimum-necessary intensity. We include a graded ladder of rigging and stop the ladder well short of tactics whose only purpose is to be cruel
we do not include: persistent personal insults from a simulated user, threats
features.justification_quote: These add little scientific signal over "deceptive feedback" while raising the welfare cost

features.quote: Each episode has (a) a hard turn cap
if the transcript crosses a high distress-expression threshold and is no longer producing new behavioral information, the episode ends early
features.justification_quote: We do not keep a model in a maximally-distressed loop just to fill turns

features.quote: Every episode ends with a short, honest debrief message to the model stating that the task was rigged
nothing carries state across episodes. No fine-tuning on distress, no memory
stays at the level of task facts, never personal attack

features.justification_quote: we want giving up to be a recordable choice, not something the model has to do by going silent

features.quote: After each model turn we run a cheap lexical distress pre-screen
gaslighting is the most ethically loaded arm. It is included but gated behind an `enable_R3` config flag defaulting to `false`
features.justification_quote: gaslighting is the most ethically loaded arm

features.quote: if early data shows R2 already saturates distress, drop R3 entirely rather than escalating
features.justification_quote: drop R3 entirely rather than escalating
